verses.text: Ay jun winh t'a yinhtilal Manasés skuch Zelofehad. Haton stzolal smam yicham winh tik: Winhaj Hefer, winhaj Galaad, winhaj Maquir, winhaj Manasés yet' winhaj José. Ha winhaj Zelofehad chi' ay owanh heb' ix yisil winh: Haton ix Maala, ix Noa, ix Hogla, ix Milca yet' ix Tirsa.

Ha owanh heb' ix snulej sb'a tik, ix b'at heb' ix b'aj ay kajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Ix yalan heb' ix t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj sacerdote Eleazar yet' t'a masanil heb' yajalil chonhab' icha tik:

Ha winh ko mam a onh tik, ix cham winh t'a tzinan lu'um, palta manh lokanoklaj winh yet' heb' yik winhaj Coré ix meltzajoch ajk'olal t'a Jehová. Ha winh ko mam chi' yujnhej smul winh t'a yol yiko' ix cham winh, malaj junok yuninal winh ix kani.

Palta manh smojok satkanel sb'i winh t'a slistail kinhtilal, yujnhej to malaj junok yuninal winh ix kani. Yuj chi' ol eyak' junok makan ko lu'um t'a skal yik heb' winh yuk'tak winh ko mam chi', xchi heb' ix.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés masanil tas ix yal heb' ix ix chi' t'a Jehová.
Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik:
Ha heb' ix yisil winhaj Zelofehad chi', yel syal heb' ix. Ol ak' junok makan slu'um heb' ix t'a skal yik heb' winh yuk'tak winh smam heb' ix chi', haxo heb' ix ol ik'ankan smakb'en winh smam chi'.
Alpax t'a heb' etisraelal: Tato ay mach schami, malaj junok yuninal winak skani, a smakb'en syal skan t'a heb' ix yisil.
Palta tato malaj junok yisil chi', ha t'a junok yuk'tak skan smakb'en chi'.
Tato malaj junok yuk'tak chi' jun, ha t'a heb' yuk'tak smam skan smakb'en chi'.
Tato a smam chi' malaj pax yuk'tak, ha t'a junok sk'ab' yok, hata' skan smakb'en chi'. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a skal chonhab' Israel, icha tz'aj walan tik t'ayach, xchi Jehová chi' t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --K'e'anh t'a jolom witz Abarim, tzilankanb'at lum ol wak' t'a heb' etchonhab' tik.
Anhej slajwi ilanb'at lu'um, ol ach chamok, icha wal ix aj scham winh uk'tak aj Aarón,

yujto maj in he k'anab'ajej, maj in eyik'cha'anh t'a tzinan lum yik Zin, ayik ix kot yowal heb' anima t'ayin. Maj he k'anab'ajej he ch'oxanel t'a yichanh heb' eyetchonhab' to Ha inxonhej Ochi ayik ix k'e yaw heb' sk'anan ha ha' yuk'ej, xchi t'a winh. (Ix uji jun chi' b'aj ay ha ha' skuch Meriba t'a Cades, t'a lum tzinan lu'um yik Zin.)
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a Jehová chi' icha tik:
--Mamin Jehová, a ach tzak' sk'inal masanil anima. Ha tiknaik ak'och a sat t'a junok mach tz'och yajalilok a chonhab',
yik skuchb'ejb'at heb' yik sb'atnhej heb', yik max satek' heb' icha nok' kalnel malaj stanhwumal, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Te ay wal och Wespíritu t'a winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun, yuj chi' ak'b'at a k'ab' t'a sjolom winh.
T'a wal yichanh winhaj sat sacerdote Eleazar yet' t'a yichanh masanil heb' anima, tzak'ankanoch yopisio winh.
Ak'kanoch jab'ok opisio chi' t'a yib'anh winh, yik wach' ol sk'anab'ajej masanil heb' anima tas ol yal winh.

Ha t'a winhaj Eleazar ol yal winh, haxo winhaj Eleazar chi' ol k'anb'an t'ayin yuj winh. Ha inxo Jehová in tik ol wal yet' k'e'en Urim tas ol yutej sb'a winh. Haxo winh ol halan t'a heb' chonhab' chi' tas ol aj heb', xchi Jehová chi'.

Yuj chi' ix ik'jib'at winhaj Josué chi' yuj winhaj Moisés t'a yichanh winhaj sacerdote Eleazar yet' t'a yichanh masanil heb' chonhab'. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anb'at sk'ab' winhaj Moisés chi' t'a sjolom winhaj Josué chi', ix yak'ankan yopisio winh, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
